detail: term sheet declares barrier_level_pct absent; booking has 70

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G10 contains no knock-in barrier provision — no barrier level, observation basis, or contingent protection language appears anywhere in the document. The booking record nevertheless carries barrier_level_pct = 70. Please confirm whether this note is in fact a barrier product and, if so, identify the governing document or supplement that sets the 70% knock-in level; if no such provision exists, confirm the booking field should be cleared.
triage.rationale: A 70% barrier is an economically material term that a desk would not book without a source, so the more likely explanation is that the term sheet provided is incomplete or superseded rather than that the booking invented the level.
